text: Sorry to message so late, I know you must be busy. My son is 8 and he's had chickenpox since yesterday, spots are really itchy but he's otherwise been himself. Tonight his temperature is 38.7 and he says his throat is sore, he is still drinking though. I got a fright earlier because the skin round his mouth looked purple but it's just from the blackcurrant squash, it wiped straight off with a cloth and he's his normal colour underneath. Just wanted to check what I should be doing about the temperature and the throat. Thanks and sorry again
